name_en: separated by ";". Analyzer output and student

Treats a² − b² as (a − b)²
description: Confuses the difference of two squares with the square of a difference.

name_en: Expands (a + b)² as a² + b²
description: Omits the middle term 2ab.

name_en: Stops before factorising completely
description: Leaves a common factor or a further difference of two squares inside a bracket.

name_en: Wrong sign inside a bracket when taking out a factor
name_zh: 提公因式時括號內符號錯
description: Especially when the factor taken out is negative.

name_en: Wrong pair of factors in the cross method
description: Product right but sum of cross products wrong or sign wrong.

name_en: Cancels terms instead of factors in a fraction
name_zh: 約分時約掉項而非因式
description: Cancels the x in (x + 2)/x, or the 3 in (3x + 1)/3.

name_en: Fails to distribute a minus sign over a bracket
name_zh: 負號未分配到括號內每項
description: −(a − b) written as −a − b.

name_en: Combines unlike terms
description: 3x + 2x² written as 5x³ or 5x.

name_en: surds
Adds indices when multiplying bases that differ
description: 2³ × 3² treated as 6⁵.

name_en: Distributes a power over a sum
description: (a + b)ⁿ written as aⁿ + bⁿ.

name_en: Reads a negative index as a negative number
description: 2⁻¹ taken as −2.

name_en: Takes a⁰ as 0
Splits a root over a sum
description: √(a² + b²) written as a + b.

name_en: Leaves a surd unsimplified or the denominator irrational
name_zh: 根式未化簡或分母未有理化

name_en: Splits a log over a sum
description: log(a + b) written as log a + log b.

name_en: Misapplies the power law
description: (log a)² confused with log a² or 2 log a.

name_en: Accepts a log equation solution outside the domain
name_zh: 對數方程未檢驗定義域
description: Keeps a root that makes the argument of a log non-positive.

name_en: Wrong direction in the change-of-base formula
Equates indices without equal bases
Sign error when transposing a term
Divides both sides by an expression that may be zero and loses a root
name_zh: 兩邊除以含未知數的式子而失根
description: x² = 3x solved as x = 3 only.

name_en: Keeps an extraneous root after squaring or clearing fractions
name_zh: 平方或去分母後未剔除增根

name_en: Keeps a root that is impossible in context (negative length / non-integer count)
name_zh: 保留在情境中不合理的根

name_en: Sign error in the quadratic formula (−b or the discriminant)
name_zh: 二次公式中 −b 或判別式符號錯
description: Uses b instead of −b, or b² + 4ac.

name_en: Divides only part of the numerator by 2a
name_zh: 二次公式只把部分分子除以 2a

name_en: Wrong inequality for the nature of roots
name_zh: 根的性質對應錯判別式條件
description: Uses Δ > 0 for equal roots, or forgets Δ = 0 in 'real roots'.

name_en: Sign error in α + β = −b/a
Reads the vertex of a(x − h)² + k as (−h k)
name_zh: 頂點 x 坐標符號錯

name_en: Does not reverse the inequality when multiplying / dividing by a negative
name_zh: 乘除負數時不等號未變向

name_en: Chooses the wrong region for a quadratic inequality
description: x² > 4 answered as x > 2 only.

name_en: Confuses 'and' with 'or' in compound inequalities
name_zh: 複合不等式混淆「及」與「或」

name_en: Shades the wrong side of a boundary line
Ignores whether the boundary is included (< vs ≤)
Reads the optimum from a non-vertex point or a non-integer point when integers are required
name_zh: 最值不在頂點或忽略整數要求

name_en: Substitutes into the same equation it came from
Translates the graph the wrong way for f(x + h)
Applies combined transformations in the wrong order
Substitutes into only part of the expression
description: f(x) = x² + x, f(2a) written as 4a² + a.

name_en: Off-by-one in the term number n
Confuses the nth term with the sum of n terms
name_zh: 混淆第 n 項與前 n 項和

name_en: Ignores a negative common ratio
Uses the sum to infinity when |r| ≥ 1
percentages
Skips finding the variation constant
Treats a partial variation as a joint variation
description: y = k₁ + k₂x written as y = kx.

name_en: Takes the percentage of the wrong base
description: A 20% decrease then 20% increase treated as returning to the original.

name_en: Adds successive percentage changes
Uses simple interest where compound is required
Wrong number of periods for the compounding frequency
Swaps the order of a ratio
Confuses absolute with relative / percentage error
name_zh: 混淆絕對誤差與相對誤差

name_en: Wrong upper / lower limit for a derived quantity
name_zh: 派生量的上下限方向錯
description: Uses the upper limit of both numerator and denominator for a maximum quotient.

name_en: States a fact without the reason
Names the wrong theorem for a step
description: 'alt. ∠s' for corresponding angles; '∠ in semicircle' where it is '∠ at centre'.

name_en: Uses SSA or AAA as a congruence condition
name_zh: 以 SSA 或 AAA 判定全等

name_en: Pairs non-corresponding sides in similar triangles
name_zh: 相似三角形對應邊配錯

name_en: Uses the length ratio for areas or volumes
name_zh: 面積或體積用了長度比

name_en: Assumes a right angle / equal length from the diagram
Doubles the wrong angle in the centre-circumference relation
name_zh: 圓心角與圓周角關係用反

name_en: Uses cyclic quadrilateral properties without four concyclic points
name_zh: 未確認四點共圓便用性質

name_en: Fails to use tangent ⊥ radius
Pairs the tangent-chord angle with the wrong inscribed angle
Mixes up volume and surface area formulas
name_zh: 混淆體積與表面積公式

name_en: Uses the height where the slant height is needed (or vice versa)
Mixes units within one calculation
Wrong fraction of the circle for an arc / sector
name_zh: 弧或扇形的圓心角分數錯

name_en: Puts a leg where the hypotenuse belongs
description: c² = a² − b² with c not the hypotenuse.

name_en: Inverts the slope (Δx / Δy)
Uses the reciprocal without the sign change for a perpendicular
Confuses the mid-point and distance formulas
Reads the centre of x² + y² + Dx + Ey + F = 0 as (D/2 E/2)
Forgets the square root for the radius
Sets up the locus from the wrong condition
Uses the wrong pair of sides for a ratio
Calculator in the wrong angle mode
Wrong sign of a ratio in a quadrant
Misses the second solution in 0°–360°
name_zh: 漏了 0°–360° 內的第二個解

name_en: Misses the ambiguous case of the sine rule
name_zh: 漏了正弦公式的兩解情況

name_en: Sign error in the cosine rule
Swaps angle of elevation and depression
Measures a bearing from the wrong reference direction
Takes the angle in the wrong plane in a 3-D problem
name_zh: 三維問題取錯平面上的角

name_en: Rounds an intermediate value too early
Takes the median of unsorted data
Uses class boundaries instead of class marks for a grouped mean
name_zh: 分組平均數用了組界而非組中值

name_en: Wrong position for a quartile
Divides by n − 1 or n inconsistently
name_zh: 標準差分母 n 與 n−1 混用

name_en: Thinks adding a constant changes the dispersion
Sign of the standard score reversed
Adds probabilities of non-mutually-exclusive events
name_zh: 非互斥事件的機率直接相加

name_en: Multiplies probabilities of dependent events as if independent
name_zh: 非獨立事件當獨立相乘

name_en: Keeps the same denominator after drawing without replacement
Computes 'at least one' by adding cases and double counts
name_zh: 「至少一個」直接相加而重複計算

name_en: Confuses P(A | B) with P(B | A)
Uses P where C is needed or vice versa
Overcounts arrangements with identical objects
name_zh: 相同物件的排列重複計算

name_en: Wrong sign in the conjugate when dividing
Reduces a power of i with the wrong cycle
description: i¹⁰²⁹ taken as i or −1 by dividing by 2.

name_en: Runs a recurrence the wrong way to reach an earlier term
Counts only the first round of a turn-taking game
Differentiates the outer function only
name_zh: 只求外函數導數漏內導數
description: d/dx sin(3x) written as cos(3x).

name_en: Differentiates a product as the product of the derivatives
name_zh: 乘積的導數當成導數的乘積

name_en: Reverses the numerator of the quotient rule
Forgets the ln a factor for aˣ or logₐ x
name_zh: 漏咗 ln a 因子

name_en: Differentiates y as if it were a constant
name_zh: 隱函數求導時把 y 當常數

name_en: Concludes from f''= 0 that there is no extremum
name_zh: 由 f''=0 斷定無極值

name_en: Reports a local extremum as the global one
name_zh: 把局部極值當作整體極值
description: Ignores the endpoints of a closed interval.

name_en: Substitutes the given value before differentiating
Omits the constant of integration
Keeps the original limits after a substitution
Forgets to convert dx
Chooses u and dv the wrong way round
name_zh: 分部積分選錯 u 同 dv

name_en: Takes a signed integral as an area
name_zh: 把有正負的積分當面積

name_en: Uses the power rule on 1/x
Forgets to square the radius in the disc method
Gets the over- or under-estimate the wrong way round
name_zh: 梯形法則高估低估判斷相反

name_en: Uses a binomial model where the trials continue until a success
name_zh: 該用幾何分佈時用了二項分佈

name_en: Fails to rescale λ for a different interval
Adds terms for "at least" instead of using the complement
Reads the wrong tail of the standard normal table
Uses σ instead of σ/√n for the sample mean
name_zh: 樣本平均值用咗 σ 而非 σ/√n

name_en: Says the parameter has a 95% chance of lying in one computed interval
name_zh: 把置信區間詮釋成參數的機率

name_en: Uses the wrong z for the confidence level
name_zh: 置信水平對應的 z 值用錯

name_en: Reverses the conditioning in Bayes' theorem
name_zh: 貝葉斯定理條件方向倒轉

name_en: Treats E(X²) as (E(X))²
Treats Var(aX + b) as a Var(X) + b
Never uses the induction hypothesis in the inductive step
Omits or mis-states the base case
Assumes AB = BA
Writes (AB)⁻¹ as A⁻¹B⁻¹
Divides by a matrix
Uses the inverse method when the determinant is zero
name_zh: 行列式為零仍用逆矩陣法

name_en: Misses that a homogeneous system always has the trivial solution
name_zh: 忽略齊次方程組必有平凡解

name_en: Treats a scalar product as a vector
Reverses the order of a vector product
Treats |a + b| as |a| + |b|
Puts α in the wrong quadrant in R sin(θ + α)
name_zh: R sin(θ+α) 的 α 象限錯
